parsed.scene_description: The image shows a modern restaurant with a large circular structure in the center. The structure is made up of multiple layers of books arranged in a spiral-like pattern. The books are of different sizes and colors, and they are stacked on top of each other in a way that creates a sense of depth and dimension. The building in the background has large windows that let in natural light and offer a view of the city. The restaurant has a high ceiling with a red circular light fixture, and there are several tables and chairs scattered throughout the space. A man is standing in front of the structure, looking at it.
